subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should bundled and trusted official plugins be allowed to replace a narrower Gateway caller's scopes through `forceSyntheticClient`, and should these two session catalogs begin discovery by default on upgrade?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes a shared authorization boundary and default startup/discovery behavior; tests can verify mechanics, but only an owner can approve that permanent trust and privacy policy.

options.title: Narrow and explicitly approve
options.body: Constrain or isolate the scope replacement to the minimum catalog operation, document the trusted-owner invariant, test untrusted plugins remain constrained, and retain default-on discovery only after explicit approval.

options.title: Accept the broad trusted-plugin contract
options.body: Approve bundled and trusted official plugins as independently authorized callers that may replace request scopes, with focused regression tests and final-head upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause default-on rollout
options.body: Make catalog discovery opt-in or split the shared Gateway authorization change into separate review until the privacy and plugin-authority policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Narrow and explicitly approve
recommendation.body: Constrain or isolate the scope replacement to the minimum catalog operation, document the trusted-owner invariant, test untrusted plugins remain constrained, and retain default-on discovery only after explicit approval.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is carrying the linked product direction and the cross-plugin/Gateway implementation, making them the best available owner for the explicit boundary decision.
